title: The Bravest Singer
genre: เรื่องเล่าขำ ๆ
text:
For my father's fiftieth birthday, we took him to a karaoke room. My father loves singing, (1) he is not very good at it. He chose a famous love song and began (2) loudly. Halfway through the song, the waiter came in (3) our drinks. He stopped, listened for a moment, and then asked very seriously, "Sir, would you like me (4) a doctor?"
We all laughed (5) hard that my sister fell off the sofa. My father, (6) is always a good sport, laughed too. "If I (7) a better singer," he said, "I would be famous by now." For the rest of the evening, the waiter came back every ten minutes (8) if my father was okay.
When we left, he gave my father a small cake with a message: "Happy birthday to the bravest singer I (9) met." My father still keeps a photo of that cake on his desk, and he still sings (10) badly as ever.

items.stem: (1) My father loves singing, ___ he is not very good at it.

so ไม่สมเหตุผล
unless ไม่สมเหตุผล
items.explanation_th: ชอบร้อง แม้จะร้องไม่เก่ง = ขัดกัน → "although"
